conditions: human speech; a variety of accents; noisy surroundings; as well as a typical human
demonstration: OpenAI Whisper, 'Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision'
date_basis: first public commit of the released model and code (github.com/openai/whisper); paper on arXiv 2022-12-06
gap_or_nearest: one condition untested: noisy surroundings were tested against other systems, not against people. Compared with professional transcribers on 25 varied recordings, the all-human services were 'only a fraction of a percentage point better'; the bar is a typical person, not a professional. Earlier, but not qualifying: Microsoft's 'Achieving Human Parity in Conversational Speech Recognition' (arxiv.org/abs/1610.05256, 17 October 2016) edged past professional transcribers on the standard telephone-conversation test, but leaves two conditions untested (noisy surroundings and a variety of accents), so under the one-condition rule it cannot set the date.

conditions: read a written passage; cannot be told from a voice actor; by an expert listener
demonstration: Microsoft NaturalSpeech, 'End-to-End Text to Speech Synthesis with Human-Level Quality'
gap_or_nearest: one condition unmet: judged by ordinary listeners, not expert listeners. The paper's test (no statistically significant difference from human recordings) is taken as its test of 'cannot be told apart', and one speaker's voice (the LJSpeech recordings) is taken as 'a voice actor' (agent's reading).

conditions: perform as well as the best human entrants in the Putnam competition

Three conditions unmet or untested: graded by the maker, on a past year's exam, without the exam's time limit. The 'top human score that year was 90' figure is the maker's comparison as reported in news coverage; it is not on the model card or the repository page, and the agent could not open the competition organiser's results page (it refused the request), so it is unverified at a primary source. Also: Axiom's AxiomProver sat Putnam 2025 live under a proctor and had 8 of 12 problems solved by the end of the exam (6 December 2025), the other 4 in the following days (reservoir.lean-lang.org/@AxiomMath/Putnam2025).
notes: Moved from 'arguably arrived' on 2026-10-09: names more than one unmet or untested condition, so it fails the method's one-condition rule (agent's reading).
